text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected on streaming routes /v1/stream (eu-west). SLO breach threshold crossed. auto-paging to #incidents created. :rotating_light:

sam-oncall: ack — I'm looking. tagging infra. what services are impacted?

liz-engineer: seeing writes backed up on streaming-proxy-eu (write latencies ~2.5s, queue depth climbing). logs show repeated `write timeout` to client sockets.

amar-platform: grabbing proxy metrics. noticed a surge in slow consumers — connection window filling. net/http.Write seems to block. possible client-side backpressure.

maria-pm: any customer impact yet? which tenants?

cust-success: 2 paying customers reported partial transcript stalls via support. one reported streaming froze for ~35s before resuming. filing incident ticket #INC-3428.

sam-oncall: ok. triage plan: 1) isolate proxy write queue, 2) check keepalive/ALB timeouts, 3) consider temporary route fallback for affected tenants. liz can you paste the proxy error snippet?

liz-engineer: paste logs: ```2026-03-16T14:02:11Z streaming-proxy-eu1 ERROR write timeout conn=abcdef client=10.2.3.45 route=/v1/stream queue=482````

amar-platform: ALB keepalive looks fine (60s). but tcp retransmits ↑ on that node and kernel socket tx buffer > 64MB. suspect downstream consumers not reading.

sam-oncall: pinging a couple of slow client IPs to confirm. also bumping proxy metrics retention so we can graph per-connection tail.

maria-pm: can we notify affected customers about mitigation ETA?

cust-success: sending short note: "we're investigating streaming stalls affecting some sessions in eu-west, mitigation in progress — ETA ~10-20m"

amar-platform: quick mitigation suggestion: enable `streaming-proxy` write-timeout short-circuit (drop stuck connections after 10s) and restart pods one at a time. risk: will drop some clients but will free queues. thoughts?

sam-oncall: +1. prefer graceful drain then restart. schedule rolling restart on eu statefulset with maxUnavailable=1. liz, coordinate drain command.

liz-engineer: running `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/streaming-proxy-eu --namespace=prod` and issuing `curl` to drain endpoint on pod before kill: `POST /admin/drain?grace=5s`

deploy-bot: CI/CD: triggered restart for statefulset/streaming-proxy-eu at 14:08Z by liz-engineer. rollout in progress.

sam-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 now. adding quick alert to mute noisy downstream alerts.

amar-platform: added iptables rule to drop extreme slow TCP consumers as emergency throttle for perf testing (will remove after).

liz-engineer: first pod drained and restarted at 14:10Z, second pod draining now.

cust-success: customer update sent: "We've started restarting streaming proxies to free stalled sessions — you may see brief reconnects. We're monitoring and will follow up."

sam-oncall: p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 0.12s after first restart, p95 steady. looks promising.

maria-pm: great — any risk of recurrence?

amar-platform: root cause hypothesis: some client SDKs holding reads/slow event loop + proxy doesn't detect dead consumers quickly enough. we'll instrument read-heartbeat for next deploy and add an emergency eviction threshold.

sam-oncall: for short term, we'll push proxy config change to enforce connection idle write deadline = 10s and enable aggressive eviction for eu region. I'll open a follow-up PR.

liz-engineer: filed PR #4572 with setting `write_deadline_ms: 10000` and a test harness. will canary to eu after approval.

deploy-bot: rollout completed at 14:18Z. all streaming-proxy-eu pods Ready=3/3.

sam-oncall: last check: p99 at 0.14s, error rates normal. marking incident: mitigation successful.

maria-pm: please prepare a short status blurb for customers and create postmortem checklist. owners?

amar-platform: I'll own instrumentation bits and follow-up actions.

liz-engineer: I'll take the postmortem writeup (initial draft + metrics).

cust-success: I'll follow up with the customers who reported stalls.

sam-oncall: adding notes to incident tracker: root cause suspected slow consumers + insufficient eviction; mitigations: rolling restart, config change, iptables emergency throttle; next steps: SDK guidance + heartbeat + postmortem.

maria-pm: thanks everyone. closing the page in 30m unless any regressions. :thumbsup:
